title: Hazel and the Orbit
author: Beatrix Whitlock
blurb: Ada Almeida, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
